description: This file contains a test case for a FastAPI application that verifies dependency injection using get_db. It sets up a mock database session, patches the database session object, and uses the FastAPI TestClient to simulate a GET request to the root endpoint.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: The main FastAPI application instance used for testing.

methods.name: test_get_db()
methods.description: Test function that verifies the get_db dependency injection by mocking the database session and making a GET request to the FastAPI endpoint.

methods.name: read_root(c: Annotated[Any, Depends(get_db)])
methods.description: Endpoint handler for '/' that depends on get_db to inject a database session into the parameter c.
